tasks.title: Public health campaigns essay
tasks.instruction:
You must answer this question. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

In your English class you have been discussing how to design effective public health campaigns. Now your English teacher has asked you to write an essay.

Write an essay using all the notes and giving reasons for your point of view.

What is the most important factor in making a public health campaign successful?

Notes

Write about:

1. clear and simple messaging
2. involving local community leaders
3. ......................... (your own idea)

tasks.title: Review of a health campaign
tasks.instruction:
Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

You see this announcement in your college English-language magazine.

Reviews wanted!

Have you seen or taken part in a public health campaign recently? Write a review of the campaign for our magazine.

Describe what the campaign was about and how it communicated its message. Say how effective you think it was and whether you would recommend similar campaigns in the future.

The best reviews will be published in the next issue.

Write your review.

tasks.title: Article on health campaign ideas
tasks.instruction:
Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

You see this announcement on a youth health website.

Articles wanted!

How can we make public health campaigns more appealing to young people?

Write an article for our website suggesting one practical idea for a campaign that would get teenagers interested. Explain why your idea would work and describe what the campaign might achieve.

We will publish the best articles on our website.

Write your article.

tasks.title: Email about campaign planning
tasks.instruction:
Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

You have received this email from your English-speaking friend, Chris.

Write your email.

promptBlocks.subject: Health campaign idea
paragraphs: I'm thinking of starting a small public health campaign in our neighbourhood to encourage people to get more exercise. I know you've studied this topic. Could you tell me what you think the main message should be? Also, what practical consequence do you see if people don't become more active? And what one thing would you recommend we do in the campaign?
